question: GeoJSON of all footways (limit 5)
sql: SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geojson FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'footway' LIMIT 5

question: WKT of Passeio Marítimo de Algés
sql: SELECT ST_AsText(geometry) AS wkt FROM lisbon_roads WHERE names.primary = 'Passeio Marítimo de Algés'

question: start point lon/lat of Passeio Marítimo de Algés rounded to 4 decimals
sql: SELECT ROUND(ST_X(ST_StartPoint(geometry)), 4) AS lon, ROUND(ST_Y(ST_StartPoint(geometry)), 4) AS lat FROM lisbon_roads WHERE names.primary = 'Passeio Marítimo de Algés'

question: length in metres of first 5 residential roads rounded to 1 decimal
sql: SELECT ROUND(ST_Length(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3763', always_xy := true)), 1) AS length_m FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'residential' LIMIT 5

question: concatenated name (class) for service roads (limit 10)
sql: SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', COALESCE(names.primary, 'unnamed'), '(', class, ')') AS label FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'service' LIMIT 10

question: GeoJSON of road id 9e903112-7902-46aa-b26d-972552825416
sql: SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geojson FROM lisbon_roads WHERE id = '9e903112-7902-46aa-b26d-972552825416'
